about: The Workbench icons of the GNURobbo drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's icons/gnurobbo.48.png. GNURobbo-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, GNURobbo.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's GNURobbo.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licences; Folder.info for data.
